blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. Trained on DF2K, the 7.95M-parameter model achieves a higher PSNR than every compared multi-scale method at x4 and x8 on all five standard benchmarks. At x8, it outperforms the x8-specific DRN-L on all of them, leads all compared methods on Urban100, and is within 0.13 dB of the best result elsewhere. Against three single-scale SwinIR-M models, PMS-SR uses 22% of the parameters, runs 2.9x faster on BSD100 inputs, and its outputs agree 6.7-12.4 dB more closely. Code and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 超分辨率网络接受一个放大系数的培训,因此多个输出分辨率需要多个模型. 我们提出PMS-SR,是一个渐进式的单输入多输出网络,生产出x2,x4,而x8的结果是一个前行通路,在低分辨率网格上有一个变压器骨干. 在第一阶段,每个比分被预测为对先前比分的预测进行分解的两比分上下取样的残余. 随着Dirac和零初始化,训练完全从双子级阶梯开始,每个头只添加上个级所缺少的波段. 在第二阶段,通过空间到深度反馈、可变形对接和每像素聚变,对双向的尺度进行大规模相互完善,因此x8特性对x2输出进行了完善。 在DF2K的训练下,7.95M参数模型在所有5个标准基准上,在x4和x8上实现比每个比较多尺度方法更高的PSNR. 在x8时,它的表现超过了所有它们上X8专用的DRN-L,在Urban100上领导所有比较方法,在0.13分贝范围内达到其他地方的最佳结果. 针对三种单相标的SwinIR-M型,PMS-SR使用22%的参数,在BSD100输入上运行速度快到2.9x,其输出更接近于6.7-12.4 dB. 将在https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR上发布密码和预先训练过的模型。 接受时。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Single-image super-resolution (SISR) reconstructs a high-resolution (HR) image from a low-resolution (LR) input. It is used throughout the video pipeline, in surveillance, adaptive streaming, zoomable playback, and content remastering, as well as in medical imaging [ 1 ] and thermal infrared imaging [ 2 , 3 ] . Since SRCNN [ 4 ] introduced end-to-end learning for this task, accuracy has improved through deeper residual networks such as EDSR [ 5 ] , attention-based networks such as RCAN [ 6 ] , and, more recently, window-attention Transformers such as SwinIR [ 7 ] and HAT [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 单相超分辨率(SISR)从低分辨率(LR)输入重建出高分辨率(HR)图像. 它在整个视频管道中被使用,用于监视、适应性回流、可缩放回放和内容再做,以及医疗成像[1]和热红外成像[2,3]。 自从SRCNN[4]为这项任务引入了端到端的学习,通过更深的EDSR[5]等残留网络,基于注意力的网络如RCAN[6],以及最近的窗口关注,精度得到了提高. SwinIR [7]和HAT [8]等变形器.

blocks.en: Most of these networks are single-scale, with a separate model trained for each magnification factor. Many video systems, however, need several renditions of the same content, for example the resolution ladders of adaptive streaming, zoomable playback, and surveillance viewers that switch between an overview and a detailed view. With single-scale models, every rendition requires its own large network. Multi-scale SISR methods share this computation. LapSRN and MS-LapSRN [ 9 , 10 ] predict a Laplacian pyramid progressively, MSWSR [ 11 ] and MLWAN [ 12 ] produce multi-scale outputs in the wavelet domain, and ProSR [ 13 ] grows an asymmetric dense pyramid with strong × 8 \times 8 results. These works show that progressive × 2 \times 2 steps extend well to × 8 \times 8 and that the way the scales are coupled, through shared features and the residual anchor of each scale, largely determines multi-scale accuracy. Existing progressive methods, however, are convolutional, spend much of their computation on upsampled grids, and pass information only from coarse to fine, so evidence found at a fine scale is never used to correct the coarser outputs that the same model delivers.
blocks.zh: 这些网络大多是单级的,每个放大系数都经过了单独的模型训练. 然而,许多视频系统需要若干相同内容的移出,例如适应性流线、可放大回放和在概览和详细视图之间切换的监视取景器。 使用单级模型,每一次引渡都需要自己的大型网络. 多尺度的 SISR 方法共享此计算. LapSRN和MS-LapSRN [9,10] 预言拉普拉斯金字塔会逐渐形成,MSWSR [11]和MLWAN [12]在波浪域产生多尺度出产,而ProSR [13] 则会生长出一个不对称的密集金字塔并具有强烈的×8\时的结果. 这些作品表明,进步×2\time 2步可好地延伸至×8\time 8步,而天平的结合方式,通过共享的特征和每个天平的剩余锚,在很大程度上决定了多级的准确性. 然而,现有的渐进式方法是不断演化的,大部分的计算都花在了被检测的网格上,并且只将信息从粗到细的传递,因此在细尺度上发现的证据从未用于纠正同一种模型提供的粗度输出.

blocks.en: In this paper, we treat × 2 / × 4 / × 8 \times 2/{\times}4/{\times}8 super-resolution (SR) as one coupled reconstruction problem. All deep feature extraction is performed on the LR grid with cross-shaped window (CSWin) attention [ 14 ] , whose horizontal and vertical stripes cover both image axes at low cost, complemented by the channel attention block of HAT [ 8 ] . In Stage 1, a pyramid with decreasing channel width expands the features × → × → × 8 \times 2\!\to\!\times 4\!\to\!\times 8 by sub-pixel convolution [ 15 ] and, in the spirit of MS-LapSRN [ 10 ] , predicts each scale as a residual over the bicubic upsampling of the previous scale’s prediction, so each head only adds the band that the previous scale cannot represent. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement (IMR) refines all scales jointly: fine features are folded back to coarser grids by space-to-depth, coarse features are aligned to finer grids by deformable alignment, and a per-pixel fusion weights the streams; the × 8 \times 8 refinement runs on the × 4 \times 4 grid at one quarter of the cost.

blocks.en: Stripe attention, channel attention branches, sub-pixel upsampling, deformable warping, and residual multi-stage refinement are established components, and we reuse them unchanged. Our contribution lies in the mechanisms that couple the scales in the single-input multiple-output (SIMO) setting. The main contributions are as follows. • A SIMO formulation of × 2 / × 4 / × 8 \times 2/{\times}4/{\times}8 SR: a single 7.95M-parameter model produces all three outputs in one forward pass, and all of its attention operates on the LR grid. • Cascaded residual anchoring: each scale is anchored on the detached, bicubically upsampled prediction of the previous scale. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each higher head adds only the band that the previous scale lacks instead of the increasingly large residual left by a direct anchor. Replacing the cascade with a direct anchor costs 2.4 dB at × 8 \times 8 on BSD100 in our ablation. • Inter-scale mutual refinement (IMR): a second stage that combines space-to-depth feedback, deformable cross-scale alignment, and per-pixel fusion with a refine-then-upsample × 8 \times 8 path. Fine-to-coarse signals have been used in SR before, but only inside single-scale models (Sec. II ); here they flow between renditions that are delivered together, so × 8 \times 8 evidence also improves the × 2 \times 2 output. • Multi-scale accuracy: under the standard DF2K training and Y-channel evaluation protocol, PMS-SR has the highest PSNR among the compared multi-scale methods in every × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 entry. At × 8 \times 8 it outperforms the × 8 \times 8 -specific DRN-L on all five standard benchmarks; against the strongest published × 8 \times 8 models (SwinIR-M, DBPN-RES-MR64-3, and RDRN, with 1.5 to 4.6 times as many parameters), it is at least 0.16 dB ahead on Urban100, significantly so against SwinIR-M in a paired per-image test (adjusted p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ), and at most 0.13 dB behind elsewhere. • Cross-scale consistency with degenerate controls: we measure whether the delivered renditions agree, a property that per-factor evaluation does not capture. They agree 6.7–12.4 dB more closely than those of three independently trained models, and because agreement alone is maximized by degenerate ladders, we report it together with the fidelity of each rendition.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A CNN-Based Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: II-A 有线电视新闻网超级分辨率

blocks.en: SRCNN [ 4 ] pioneered end-to-end SISR. EDSR [ 5 ] scaled up residual networks, RCAN [ 6 ] added channel attention, and D-DBPN [ 16 ] iterated up- and down-projections; its extended version [ 17 ] remains one of the strongest × 8 \times 8 models. Sub-pixel convolution [ 15 ] moved most of the computation to the LR grid and is now the standard upsampler. EDSR and RCAN serve as the CNN references in our experiments.
blocks.zh: SRCNN [4] 先驱端到端的SISR. EDSR [5] 扩大剩余网络,RCAN [6] 增加了频道关注度,D-DBPN [16] 重排上下投影;其扩展版 [17] 仍然是最强的×8\时8个模型之一. 子像素分解 [15] 将大部分计算移到 LR 网格,现在是标准上标. EDSR和RCAN是我们实验中CNN的参考文献.

blocks.en: II-B Transformer and State-Space Models
blocks.zh: II-B 变形器和国地空间模型

blocks.en: Following ViT [ 18 ] and Swin [ 19 ] , SwinIR [ 7 ] brought window attention to image restoration. Later Transformers such as EDT [ 20 ] , SRFormer [ 21 ] , and HAT [ 8 ] , and state-space models such as MambaIR [ 22 ] , MambaIRv2 [ 23 ] , and SRMamba-T [ 24 ] , are also single-scale, and most of them serve as our single-scale references (Sec. IV-C ). Compact state-space SR for thermal images, with fewer than one million parameters [ 3 ] , also trains one model per factor. Among anisotropic window designs [ 25 ] , CSWin [ 14 ] pairs full-axis horizontal and vertical stripes, and HAT showed that a parallel channel attention branch complements window attention. We build on this line by combining CSWin stripes with the channel attention of HAT and by using NAFNet blocks [ 26 ] in the shallow feature extraction and reconstruction modules.
blocks.zh: 在VIT [18] 和 Swin [19] 之后,SwinIR [7] 将窗口注意力引向图像恢复. 后期的变形器如EDT [20],SRFormer [21],和HAT [8],以及状态-空间模型如MambaIR [22],MambaIRv2 [23],和SRMamba-T [24],也是单相标,其中多数作为我们的单相标(Sec. IV-C.). 收缩用于热成像的状态-空间SR,参数不足一百万 [3] ,也训练出每个因子一个模型. 在同位素窗口设计 [25]中,CSWin [14] 对齐全轴水平和垂直条纹,而HAT显示平行的通道注意力分支补充了窗口注意力. 我们利用这条线,将CSWin条纹与HAT的信道注意力结合起来,并在浅层地物提取和重建模块中使用NAFNet块[26]。

blocks.en: II-C Progressive and Multi-Scale Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 二-C 渐进式和多比例式超级决议

blocks.en: MDSR [ 5 ] shares a feature extractor across × 2 \times 2 , × 3 \times 3 , and × 4 \times 4 but produces only one scale per forward pass. LapSRN and MS-LapSRN [ 9 , 10 ] predict Laplacian residuals progressively with deep supervision. MSSR [ 27 ] , MSWSR [ 11 ] , and MLWAN [ 12 ] output multiple scales with compact convolutional or wavelet-based designs, and ProSR-L [ 13 ] grows an asymmetric dense pyramid and reports the strongest published multi-scale × 8 \times 8 results. PMS-SR differs from these methods in three respects: its stripe-window Transformer backbone operates only on the LR grid, its anchors form a bicubic cascade over predicted images rather than over the LR input, and a second stage couples the scales in both directions. ProSR also reports that anchoring on the outputs of the previous level can destabilize training; our detached cascade anchor (Sec. III-B ) keeps this anchor while blocking the gradients of higher scales. Arbitrary-scale methods with implicit functions [ 28 ] also serve several factors with one network, but they decode each factor in a separate pass; we compare with fixed-factor methods only.
blocks.zh: MDSR [5] 共享一个特性提取器,横跨 × 2\times 2, × 3\times 3, 和 × 4\times 4, 但每个前传只产生一个比例尺. LapSRN和MS-LapSRN[9,10]在深度监督下逐渐预测了拉普拉西亚残骸. MSSR [27],MSWSR [11],和MLWAN [12] 输出多级平面,并带有紧凑的革命或以波浪为主的设计,而ProSR-L [13] 则生长出不对称的密集金字塔并报告最强的已公布多级平面×8\时8分的结果. PMS-SR在三个方面与这些方法不同:其条形窗形变形器主干线仅在LR网格上运行,其锚与预测的图像形成双立相接级,而不是LR输入相接;第二阶段对双向相接相接. 赞成 斯洛伐克共和国还报告说,依靠上一级产出会破坏培训的稳定;我们分离的级联锚(Sec. III-B)保持这种锚,同时阻断更高级别的梯度。 带有隐性函数的任意尺度方法[28]也服务于一个网络的几个因素,但它们在单独的通过中解码出每个因素;我们只与固定因素方法作比较.

blocks.en: Another line of work passes information from fine back to coarse, but within a single factor: D-DBPN [ 16 ] alternates up- and down-projections so that LR-grid errors correct the HR features, SRFBN [ 29 ] feeds a hidden state back to the input over unfolded iterations, and DRN [ 30 ] adds a dual regression that maps the SR output back to the LR input. These methods show that fine-to-coarse signals help, but each delivers one factor, so the returned signal has no coarser output to revise; IMR instead exchanges information between the three delivered renditions.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作将信息从精细回转粗细,但在单一因素内: D-DBPN [16] 相继上下投影,使 LR-网格错误纠正了 HR 特性, SRFBN [29] 将一个隐藏状态反馈到所展开重迭的输入, DRN [30] 增加了一个双回归,将 SR 输出映射回 LR 输入. 这些方法表明从细到粗的信号有帮助,但每个信号都提供一个因子,因此返回的信号没有可修改的相近输出;而是由IMR在三个发送的引渡之间交换信息.

blocks.en: II-D Feature Alignment in Restoration
blocks.zh: II-D 恢复中的特征调整

blocks.en: Cross-resolution alignment is a recurring problem in restoration. EDVR [ 31 ] popularized deformable alignment for video restoration, and DCNv2 [ 32 ] underlies most modern alignment modules. The multi-stage MPRNet [ 33 ] motivates the residual refinement used in IMR, to which we add zero-initialized deformable alignment for cross-scale misalignment and a per-pixel softmax gate.
blocks.zh: 跨分辨率对接是修复中反复出现的问题. EDVR [31] 为视频修复而普及的变形配对,而DCNv2 [32]是大多数现代配对模块的基础. 多相的MPRNet [33] 激发了IMR中使用的剩余精细度,其中我们增加了零初始变形对接,用于跨级错配和每像素软max门.

blocks.en: We report results on the five standard benchmarks, Set5 [ 42 ] (5 images), Set14 [ 43 ] (14 images), BSD100 [ 44 ] (100 images), Urban100 [ 45 ] (100 images), and Manga109 [ 46 ] (109 images), at × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , and × 8 \times 8 , with LR inputs generated by bicubic downsampling in the MATLAB imresize convention [ 35 ] after modulo cropping. Because SR papers use one image from each of the 109 Manga109 volumes, we checked that our copy is the standard set: its bicubic PSNRs at × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 (30.82 and 24.90 dB) agree within 0.02 dB with those in [ 6 ] (30.80 and 24.89 dB), and the released SwinIR-M model reproduces its published Manga109 scores exactly (39.92/0.9797 at × 2 \times 2 and 32.03/0.9260 at × 4 \times 4 ).

blocks.en: Following common practice [ 6 , 10 , 13 ] , peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity (SSIM) [ 47 ] are computed on the Y (luminance) channel of YCbCr after conversion from sRGB, on 8-bit images with s s border pixels removed at scale s s . The Stage-2 outputs are evaluated. At × 8 \times 8 , we also report the learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) [ 48 ] (AlexNet backbone, lower is better). To test whether a difference between two methods is systematic, we apply the two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test [ 49 ] to the per-image Y-PSNR differences on each benchmark and adjust the resulting p p -values with the Holm procedure [ 50 ] over the benchmarks of each comparison.

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in PyTorch 2.2 (CUDA 12.1) and run on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU (24 GB). blocks.en: Table I compares PMS-SR with the other multi-scale methods, the most direct comparison. Published values come from the original papers (ProSR SSIM from its supplementary material; MSWSR from the compilation in [ 12 ] ), and MDSR does not support × 8 \times 8 . The cells marked † were measured under our protocol and fill unpublished entries: the released MDSR model, the single released MSWSR checkpoint, which produces × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , and × 8 \times 8 outputs, and the ProSR-L checkpoints on the authors’ project page for Set5 and Manga109, which ProSR does not report. Our pipeline reproduces the published MSWSR results within 0.02 dB, the result images released with ProSR-L score within 0.06 dB of its published values, and its checkpoints reproduce the Set5 scores of those images within 0.02 dB. The released MDSR weights, a PyTorch port of the original model, reproduce the published MDSR results only within − 0.12 -0.12 to + 0.09 +0.09 dB, so the MDSR † entries carry this uncertainty. ProSR-S is omitted because its weights are no longer available and ProSR-L is more accurate in every reported entry. PMS-SR+ uses the geometric self-ensemble [ 5 ] ; like the DIV2K-only control (same architecture, 800 DIV2K images, one third of the schedule), it is shown for reference and not ranked.

blocks.en: At × 8 \times 8 , which MDSR cannot produce, PMS-SR is the best multi-scale method in every PSNR entry and in every SSIM entry except Set14, where MLWAN reports a higher SSIM (0.6574 vs. 0.6551) with a 0.40 dB lower PSNR. PMS-SR is 0.08–0.32 dB better than ProSR-L, which has about twice as many parameters, and 0.42–1.68, 0.26–1.07, and 0.33–1.37 dB better than MS-LapSRN, MLWAN, and MSWSR, respectively. It also leads every column at × 4 \times 4 . At × 2 \times 2 , it leads on Urban100 and is within 0.05 dB of ProSR-L on Set5, Set14, and BSD100, with the highest SSIM on Set5; on Manga109, ProSR-L † and MDSR † are 0.18 and 0.17 dB ahead, which may reflect the low weight given to × 2 \times 2 in our objective ( 15 ). The DIV2K-only control separates the effect of the training data. Trained on DIV2K with one third of the schedule, it already comes close to ProSR-L at × 8 \times 8 with half of its parameters ( + 0.02 +0.02 dB on Urban100, equal on BSD100, and − 0.09 -0.09 , − 0.10 -0.10 , and − 0.16 -0.16 dB on Set5, Set14, and Manga109). At × 8 \times 8 it also stays within 0.2 dB of the DIV2K-trained RCAN and the DF2K-trained DRN-L on every benchmark (Table III ). The design therefore accounts for most of the lead over MSWSR and MLWAN and reaches nearly the accuracy of ProSR-L at half its size, whereas the margin over ProSR-L also reflects the larger training set and the full schedule.

blocks.en: SIMO and single-input single-output (SISO) models solve different deployment problems, so this comparison is asymmetric by design: each SISO model is trained for one factor, and a ladder of three such models has at least 4.5 × 4.5\times the parameters of PMS-SR. Table I is therefore our primary comparison, and Table III shows how much PMS-SR gives up, or gains, by covering three factors with one model. Except for the † rows, all baseline values are published results; the Manga109 and × 8 \times 8 values of EDSR and the × 8 \times 8 values of D-DBPN follow the compilations in RCAN [ 6 ] and SAN [ 51 ] , and the × 8 \times 8 values of SwinIR-M come from its supplementary material. The † rows are our whole-image measurements of the released DRN-L weights. The same pipeline reproduces the published results of DRN-L within 0.02 dB and those of SwinIR-M, including its × 8 \times 8 results, within 0.05 dB.

blocks.en: At × 8 \times 8 , PMS-SR outperforms EDSR, D-DBPN, RCAN, SAN, and the × 8 \times 8 -specific DRN-L [ 30 ] on all five benchmarks. On Set5 it is 0.53 dB above the 45.5M EDSR and 0.18 dB above RCAN, and it exceeds DRN-L by 0.38 dB on Urban100 (23.36 vs. 22.98 dB) and by 0.26 dB on Manga109 (25.58 vs. 25.32 dB). Three published × 8 \times 8 models are stronger on some benchmarks: SwinIR-M [ 7 ] , DBPN-RES-MR64-3 [ 17 ] , and RDRN [ 52 ] , with 12.1M, 23.1M, and about 36M parameters for × 8 \times 8 alone. Where they are ahead of PMS-SR (on Set5, Set14, BSD100, or Manga109), the margin is at most 0.13 dB, whereas PMS-SR is at least 0.16 dB ahead of all of them on Urban100, with the highest SSIM there as well. PMS-SR is also not significantly different from SwinIR-M on BSD100 and Manga109 in the paired test below (adjusted p = 0.17 p=0.17 and 0.52 0.52 ), while using 22% of the parameters of three SwinIR-M models. HAT, HMA, and the Mamba-based models do not report × 8 \times 8 results.

Against DRN-L the advantage is broader: PMS-SR is better on all 100 Urban100 images (median gain 0.249 dB), on 102 of the 109 Manga109 images (0.191 dB), and on 85 of the 100 BSD100 images (adjusted p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} in all three cases). blocks.en: Table II summarizes the single-scale comparison from the viewpoint of a multi-scale model. The gap to SwinIR-M shrinks from − 0.55 -0.55 dB on average at × 2 \times 2 to − 0.18 -0.18 dB at × 4 \times 4 and becomes slightly positive at × 8 \times 8 . It never widens with the factor on any benchmark and is positive at × 8 \times 8 on three of the five benchmarks, significantly so on Urban100. This trend is consistent with the design: the objective gives the largest weight to the hardest factor ( 15 ), the cascaded anchors keep the shared backbone from being spent on the factor that bicubic interpolation already serves well, and the IMR gains are larger at × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 than at × 2 \times 2 (Table IV ). A system that must deliver all three renditions thus gives up 0.2–1.0 dB at × 2 \times 2 against an 11.8M single-scale model and obtains × 8 \times 8 results on par with the strongest single-scale × 8 \times 8 models, with 22% of the parameters of the three-model ladder.

blocks.en: As in EDSR+ and RCAN+ [ 5 , 6 ] , PMS-SR+ averages the outputs over the eight standard flips and rotations at eight times the inference cost. The gain is positive in all fifteen benchmark–factor combinations ( + 0.03 +0.03 to + 0.21 +0.21 dB) and, at every factor, largest on Manga109 and Urban100, whose line art and repeated structures benefit most from averaging over orientations. Because the same technique applies to every baseline, PMS-SR+ is not ranked against single models; against published self-ensembles at × 8 \times 8 , it is ahead of RCAN+ [ 6 ] on all five benchmarks, of SwinIR+ [ 7 ] on BSD100, Urban100, and Manga109, and of RDRN+ [ 52 ] only on Urban100.
blocks.zh: 与EDSR+和RCAN+[5,6]一样,PMS-SR+将8个标准翻转和旋转的输出平均为推断成本的8倍. 所有15个基准-因素组合(+0.03+0.03至+0.21+0.21分贝)的增益是正数,在每一个因素中,曼加109和Urban100都是最大的,其线路艺术和重复结构从平均取向偏重得益最大. 由于同样的技术适用于每个基准,PMS-SR+的排名不与单个模型相比;相对于所公布的8\times 8的自演,在所有五个基准上都领先于RCAN+ [6],在BSD100,Urban100,和Manga109上则领先于RDRN+ [52] Urban100.

blocks.en: On Manga109, PMS-SR leads every × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 entry among the multi-scale methods, by 0.30 and 0.29 dB over ProSR-L † . blocks.en: Table VI compares the cost of producing all three renditions of one input, with floating-point operations (FLOPs) counted by the thop library on the same 64 × 64 64{\times}64 LR input. Whole-image inference, which stays within − 0.02 -0.02 to + 0.12 +0.12 dB of the tiled protocol of the accuracy tables (Sec. IV-B ), needs 142.17 GFLOPs for all three outputs, fewer than the 159.15 GFLOPs of the SwinIR-M ladder, with 22% of its parameters. The tiled mode processes overlapping tiles and needs 2.25 times as many FLOPs. SwinIR-M is the strongest competitor with released weights for all three factors (weights are also released for RCAN, which is weaker at every factor). Among the multi-scale methods, MSWSR is the most recent with released × 8 \times 8 weights; it is much smaller (1.23M parameters) but 0.33–1.37 dB less accurate at × 8 \times 8 . The full ladder needs fewer FLOPs than three SwinIR-M models in whole-image mode and less runtime in both modes, because attention runs only on the LR grid and the cross-scale exchange for × 8 \times 8 runs on the × 4 \times 4 grid. Fig. 7 summarizes the trade-off at × 8 \times 8 : PMS-SR reaches the five-benchmark mean of SwinIR-M, DBPN-RES-MR64-3, and RDRN (25.37 vs. 25.35–25.38 dB) with at most 22% of the parameters of their three-model ladders.

blocks.en: On an otherwise idle RTX 4090, one whole-image PMS-SR pass delivers all three renditions in 32.8 ms, against 94.4 ms for the SwinIR-M ladder on the same inputs. At this input size, the 2.9 × 2.9\times speed-up is much larger than the 1.12 × 1.12\times FLOPs ratio because the ladder pays the fixed per-network overhead three times; for larger inputs, where arithmetic dominates, the speed-up is expected to approach the FLOPs ratio. The tiled mode takes 47.1 ms and is still 2.0 × 2.0\times faster than the ladder. The derived ladder is the cheapest option (32.6 ms), but all of its renditions are tied to the × 8 \times 8 output.

blocks.en: A SIMO model delivers several renditions of one input, so a property that per-factor evaluation never measures becomes relevant: whether the renditions agree with one another. Table VII measures this for a single LR input as the Y-PSNR between the downsampled higher-factor output and the delivered lower-factor output on the five benchmarks. PMS-SR reaches 45.6–52.4 dB ( × → × 4 \times 8\!\rightarrow\!\times 4 ) and 45.5–50.9 dB ( × → × 2 \times 4\!\rightarrow\!\times 2 ), against 34.5–42.5 dB and 38.3–44.3 dB for three independent SwinIR-M models, an advantage of 6.7–12.4 dB that is largest on Urban100.

Agreement alone is not evidence of quality. A bicubic ladder reaches about 62 dB at × → × 4 \times 8\!\rightarrow\!\times 4 because it adds no detail, and a derived ladder (a × 8 \times 8 model followed by downsampling) is consistent by construction, so agreement must be read together with fidelity. In the fidelity columns, PMS-SR gives the most accurate × 2 \times 2 renditions of the non-control systems on all five benchmarks, and on the two 100-image benchmarks its × 2 \times 2 and × 8 \times 8 renditions are the most accurate of all tested systems (e.g., 32.58 and 25.07 dB on BSD100). PMS-SR is also more accurate than the derived ladder at every factor on BSD100 and Urban100 (by up to 0.19 dB), whereas the derived ladder, whose × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 renditions are only downsampled × 8 \times 8 outputs, is 0.07–0.15 dB ahead on the small Set5 and Set14. Three independent models have competitive fidelity but the weakest agreement.
blocks.zh: 仅靠协议不能证明质量。 一个双立方梯在 ~ ~ 4\times 8\times!\rightarrow\!\times 4 时达到大约 62 dB,因为它没有添加细节,一个衍生出梯子(a → 8\times 8 型,后为下采样)通过构造一致,因此协议必须结合忠诚来解读. 在忠义栏中,PMS-SR在所有五个基准上给出最准确的×2\times 2 递解非控制系统,在两个100-image基准上,其×2\times 2和x8\times 8 递解是最准确的被测试系统(如BSD100上的32.58和25.07 dB). PMS-SR也比BSD100和Urban100(以0.19分贝为单位)上每个因子的所衍生出阶梯更准确;而所衍生出阶梯,其×2分2和4分4的递解只被下标出×8分8分8的输出,在小Set5和Set14上则领先于0.07-0.15分贝. 三种独立模式具有竞争性忠诚,但最弱的协议。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Three design decisions keep × 8 \times 8 affordable in one SIMO pass: deep feature extraction is confined to the LR grid with a narrowing channel pyramid, detached cascaded anchors limit each head to the band the previous scale lacks (the most important axis in Table V ), and IMR couples the scales in both directions, with larger gains at × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 than at × 2 \times 2 (Table IV ). Our training also uses only about 30% of the sample budget of SwinIR, so further gains may be possible.
blocks.zh: 3项设计决定使x8\times 8在1 SIMO通行证中负担得起:深层地物提取被限制在LR网格上,通道金字塔缩小,脱落的级联锚将每个头限制在上个标尺所缺少的波段上(表五中最重要的轴线),而IMR夫妇双向标尺,在x4\times 4和x8\times 8上的收益大于x2\times 2上的收益(表四)。 我们的训练也只用了SwinIR的样本预算的30%左右,因此可能进一步的收益.

blocks.en: For video systems, the single-pass design suits services that keep several renditions of one source. An edge node that upscales a low-bitrate stream can produce the whole ladder in one pass instead of running three SwinIR-M-class models with 4.5 × 4.5\times the parameters. Because the renditions are mutually consistent (Sec. IV-F ), switching between factors changes the viewed content much less than with independent models. Downsampling one × 8 \times 8 output (the derived ladder in Tables VI and VII ) gives exact agreement at a lower cost, but its × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 renditions are only downsampled × 8 \times 8 outputs, and on the two 100-image benchmarks PMS-SR is more accurate at every factor.
blocks.zh: 就视频系统而言,单行道设计套装服务保存着多个来源的引渡。 一个边缘节点,将一个低比特率流升级,可以在一个通过中产生出整个梯子,而不是运行三个有4.5×4.5\时参数的SwinIR-M级模型. 由于引渡是相互一致的(Sec. IV-F),不同因素之间的切换比独立模型对所看到内容的改变要少得多。 降标 1×8\times 8输出(表六和七中衍生出阶梯)以更低的成本给出了精确的一致,但其分数 2\times 2和4\times 4 引渡只被降标 × 8\times 8输出,在两个百相通基准上,PMS-SR在每个因素上都更准确.

blocks.en: V-A Limitations
blocks.zh: 五-A 限制

blocks.en: Three limitations should be noted. First, the accuracy ranking depends on the factor: PMS-SR is on par with the strongest single-scale models at × 8 \times 8 and competitive at × 4 \times 4 , whereas at × 2 \times 2 single-scale Transformers remain 0.2–1.8 dB ahead (Table III ). Our objective gives the largest weight to the hardest factor ( 15 ), and the × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 heads are trained against bicubically downsampled targets (Sec. III-D ), which may also contribute; a deployment that prioritizes × 2 \times 2 would need to rebalance these weights. Second, the sub-pixel pyramid restricts the factors to powers of two. Non-dyadic factors require an extra branch or resampling, and arbitrary-scale operation (Sec. II ) is outside our scope. Third, all experiments use single images with the bicubic degradation; real-world degradations [ 56 ] are not modeled. Temporal consistency is not modeled either, and per-frame application does not prevent flicker; cross-scale consistency (Table VII ) is a different property from cross-frame consistency. Extending the cascaded anchors and IMR along the time axis is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 应当指出三个局限性。 首先,精度排名取决于因素:PMS-SR与最强的单级模型在×8\times 8,竞争在×4\times 4,而在×2\times 2单级变压器仍然领先0.2–1.8分贝(表三). 我们的目标对最难的因素(15个)给予最大的权重,而x2\times 2和x4\times 4头被针对双子被下标(Sec. III-D.)进行训练,这可能也会有所贡献;一个优先部署x2\times 2需要重新平衡这些权重. 其次,子像素金字塔将系数限制在两个功率上. 非分化因素需要额外的分支或再生,任意规模操作(Sec. II)不属于我们的范围. 第三,所有实验都使用单相图像与双相降解;现实世界的降解[56]没有被建模. 时间一致性也没有模型化,每帧应用不能防止闪烁;跨尺度一致性(表七)与跨帧一致性是不同的属性. 沿着时间轴延长级联锚和IMR是下一个自然步骤。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PMS-SR, a progressive Transformer-based SIMO framework that reconstructs × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , and × 8 \times 8 images in a single forward pass. Its CSWin backbone is deliberately standard and confined to the LR grid. The contribution lies in how the three renditions are coupled: cascaded anchors start the optimization exactly from the bicubic cascade and limit each head to the band the previous scale lacks, and inter-scale mutual refinement exchanges information between the scales in both directions, with the × 8 \times 8 refinement computed on the × 4 \times 4 grid. With 7.95M parameters, PMS-SR has the highest PSNR among the compared multi-scale methods in every × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 entry. At × 8 \times 8 , it outperforms the × 8 \times 8 -specific DRN-L on all five benchmarks, gives the best Urban100 result among the compared methods, and stays within 0.13 dB of the strongest × 8 \times 8 -specific models elsewhere. One pass of one model, with 22% of the parameters of a three-model ladder, delivers all three renditions. Future work includes curriculum-style scale scheduling [ 13 ] , extension of the pyramid to arbitrary factors, and application of the cascaded anchors and IMR to video SR and joint restoration.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 PMS-SR, 一个进步的基于变形器的 SIMO 框架, 它重建 × 2\times 2, × 4\times 4, 和 8\times 8 图像在一个前传。 它的CSWin主干部分是故意标准化的并局限于LR网格. 其贡献在于三个递解的结合方式:级联锚从双管级联开始精确地优化,将每个头限制在上个级所缺乏的波段;在两个方向的尺度之间进行规模间相互完善的信息交流,由xx8\times 8精细计算出x4\times 4格. PMS-SR的参数为7.95M,在每×4分4分8分8分8分8分8分8分8分的比较多尺度方法中,PMS-SR拥有最高的PSNR. 在x8\times 8中,它在所有五个基准上都超过了x8\times 8——特定的DRN-L,在比较方法中给出了最佳的Urban100结果,并停留在最强的x8\times 8——特定模型的0.13分贝以内. 一个型号的一通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通. 未来的工作包括课程式的尺度排程[13],将金字塔延伸至任意因素,以及应用级联主播和IMR来录制SR并联合修复.
